sector_model: Software work management SaaS (foreign private issuer, US GAAP, files 20-F and 6-K): value on EV to revenue, FCF and FCF after SBC, net retention, remaining performance obligations, restructuring and buyback effects; adjusted FCF and non-GAAP margins are management definitions.
thesis: monday.com (Nasdaq: MNDY). Q3 2026 release (6-K Ex 99.1, 2026-11-09) read in full for the figures cited: revenue 377.5M (+19%), 9M 1,093.4M vs 898.1M; GAAP operating income 31.2M (8%), GAAP NI 35.2M, 9M NI 66.7M; net dollar retention 108%; cRPO 759M (+22%); AI ARR 36M. Q4 guide revenue 380M to 382M (about +14%), non-GAAP operating margin about 18% vs 24% in Q3; FY26 revenue 1,473M to 1,475M, adjusted FCF 282M to 288M. The 2026-07-22 6-K shows a restructuring plan cutting about 20% of the workforce. Balance sheet 2026-09-30: cash 869.6M plus marketable securities 229.8M, no debt line, total liabilities 931.4M, equity 688.6M (down from 1,246.8M after 735.0M of share repurchases in 9M26). Price: close 74.04 on 2026-11-18 x about 42.59M Q3 weighted basic shares (approximation, point in time count not read) = about 3,153M market cap; net cash about 1,099M, EV about 2,054M = 1.44x TTM revenue 1,427.3M. TTM GAAP NI 143.4M (22.0x); TTM OCF 240.1M, less PP&E 17.2M = FCF 222.9M (7.1% of market cap; capitalized software not deducted for the FY25 part, about 3M); TTM SBC 140.3M, so FCF after SBC about 82.7M (2.6%). Market may be pricing a seat based SaaS vendor facing AI disruption and decelerating growth (Q4 guide +14% from +19%); the evidence that differs is a net cash balance sheet, 24% Q3 non-GAAP operating margin and 5,038 customers above 50K ARR (+26%). Not a verified bargain: growth is slowing sharply and FCF fell.
counterthesis: Q3 OCF fell to 20.4M from 95.1M (accrued expenses -87.1M, restructuring payments 47.2M) and 9M OCF fell to 180.4M from 274.0M; adjusted FCF margin 17% vs 29%. Management guides Q4 growth near 14% and operating margin down to 18% citing near term operational headwinds from the AI first transformation. Net retention 108% and paid customers above 10 users only +5%. Adjusted FCF and non-GAAP income exclude SBC (140.3M TTM), restructuring, a 18.0M share donation to the Foundation and restructuring cash; GAAP operating margin 8% and 5% 9M. Equity fell by 45% after buybacks. Seat based pricing is exposed to AI agents and cheaper rivals. Non-GAAP guide growth may mask FX.
invalidation: Invalidated if revenue growth falls below about 12% without an offsetting margin gain, net dollar retention drops below 105%, cRPO growth falls below revenue growth, adjusted FCF margin stays below 15%, or restructuring charges recur beyond the announced plan.
